Marcus, I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (subject "Thornbury 2027 rate") in your mailbox, but I left the rate out for now.

Hollis is on the Central team, not the North account, so a per-seat rate can't go to her without approval. Finance figures only go to Anselm, June, and you as the account owner. I've asked June Osei-Lark in a DM to approve it. The draft has a placeholder where the $2,101 figure goes. Once June approves, I'll fill it in, and you can send it yourself.
